profile.headline: Software Engineer | Specializing in Python, APIs, React and AWS
profile.summary:
I’m a Full Stack Software Developer with 8+ years of experience building reliable, scalable, and maintainable software across a wide range of industries. I specialize in backend development with Python and Django, and I enjoy creating clean, responsive user experiences with React, Vue, and TailwindCSS on the frontend.

Throughout my career, I’ve built complex, data-driven applications, improved cloud infrastructure in AWS, and helped teams ship higher-quality software faster. I’m comfortable working across the entire stack—writing efficient backend services, designing APIs, building CI/CD pipelines, optimizing cloud workloads, and improving test coverage and deployment workflows.

As a consultant and former team developer, I’ve contributed to architectural decisions, mentored other engineers, and introduced processes that improved reliability, performance, and maintainability across engineering teams. I love tackling challenging problems, diving into unfamiliar technologies, and delivering solutions that make a measurable impact.

Core strengths:
• Python, Django, DRF
• React, Vue, JavaScript, TailwindCSS
• AWS (Lambda, ECS/Fargate, SQS/SNS, EC2)
• Docker/Podman, CI/CD (GitLab, Jenkins)
• Data engineering with NumPy, Pandas
• Testing frameworks (Pytest, Selenium)
• Building scalable microservices and large-dataset tooling

I’m always interested in connecting with other developers, teams, and organizations who care about clean code, solid engineering practices, and building products the right way.

positions.title: Software Engineer Consultant
positions.description:
- Develop new features using Python, Django, Vue, and React based on evolving client requirements.
- Utilize Claude, Cursor, and Lovable to assist in building high quality applications quickly.
- Improve long-term maintainability by recommending and implementing enhanced testing, documentation, and code-review processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Django · Django REST Framework · Vue.js · AWS · Claude · Cursor

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed statistical analysis tools within a microservices architecture using Python, NumPy, and Pandas to process large datasets.
- Maintained and optimized AWS Lambda functions used in ETL workflows, improving reliability and throughput.
- Implemented logging and created performance dashboards in Splunk, enabling quick identification of processing bottlenecks and guiding more efficient solutions.
- Participated in architectural planning and process improvements to enhance code quality, performance, and maintainability.
- Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using GitLab to streamline deployment and testing workflows.
- Used Docker and Podman to create containerized applications deployed on AWS ECS/Fargate.
- Mentored junior developers and provided guidance to improve team productivity and code quality.
- Increased deployment stability and reduced deployment times by improving test coverage, test robustness, and test execution speed.
positions.insights: Skills: Podman · Pandas · Docker · Gitlab · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Code Review · Python · AWS Lambda · pytest · AWS CDK

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Use Python, Django, Javascript, React, HTML, CSS and JQuery to build  and maintain features of the core database driven applications.
- Build Tools for importing, exporting, structuring and otherwise transferring data between systems using Python.
- Understand, document and recreate legacy codebase written in Java in Python/Django.

positions.title: IT Analyst I - Web Developer
positions.description:
- Utilize Python, Django and jQuery to design web applications to meet client needs.
- Design databases that support web applications.
- Resolve emergency issues with deployed applications in a timely manner.
- Collaborate with internal teams to convert end user feedback into meaningful and improved solutions.
Perform research to explore and identify new technological platforms.

positions.title: Student Developer
positions.description:
- Develop web solutions for customers utilizing Django.
- Meet with customers and team members to discuss upcoming projects, project requirements, and receive feedback on implemented solutions.
